title: Confetti Ash Veil
description: An abstract composition featuring a dense cloud of multicolored circular dots and fragments floating against a dark, smoky brown background. Thin, glowing orange embers and delicate white smoke trails rise from the bottom and sides, creating a sense of burning disintegration.
prompt: abstract painting of countless overlapping translucent circles and dots in muted rainbow colors floating in a dense cloud formation against a dark smoky brown background, glowing orange embers and thin white smoke tendrils drifting upwards, atmospheric and melancholic, fine details, soft blending, moody lighting
